Capital Accounts Summary — Edit

The Capital Accounts Summary form is used to configure report parameters.

Set date ranges and options to analyze capital account movements and balances.

Title

Enter a custom title for this report. Leave blank to use the default 'Capital Accounts Summary' title.

Description

Enter an optional description to appear under the report title.

From

Select the start date for the reporting period.

To

Select the end date for the reporting period.

Rounding

Choose how to round monetary amounts in the report. This helps simplify large numbers.

Reverse signs

Check this box to reverse the sign of all amounts. This can help match reporting conventions.

Exclude zero balances

Check this box to hide accounts with zero balances from the report.

Footer

Enter optional text to appear at the bottom of the report.
